> Official EcoFlow US online store for whole-home backup systems, portable power stations, solar generators, smart living products, and energy accessories. Find current prices, availability, configurations, and purchasing options at the [EcoFlow US store](https://us.ecoflow.com).

Product availability, specifications, pricing, warranty terms, installation services, and purchasing options may change. Use live product pages for current information.

- [Portable Solar Panels](https://us.ecoflow.com/collections/portable-solar-panels): Solar panels for portable charging at home, while traveling, or off grid.

## Featured Whole-Home Backup Systems

- [EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra X](https://us.ecoflow.com/products/delta-pro-ultra-x): Modular whole-home backup system for higher household power requirements, scalable storage, system expansion, and integrated home energy management.
- [EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra](https://us.ecoflow.com/products/delta-pro-ultra): Expandable whole-home backup system supporting solar charging and integration with compatible home energy components.

| Parameter | DELTA Pro Ultra X | DELTA Pro Ultra |
|---|---|---|
| Output per inverter / maximum system output | 12 kW / 36 kW with 3 inverters | 7.2 kW / 21.6 kW with 3 inverters |
| Starting configuration / maximum system capacity | 12.288 kWh / 184.32 kWh | 6.144 kWh / 90 kWh |
| Backup switchover | Under 20 ms with Smart Home Panel 3 | Under 20 ms with Smart Home Panel 2 |
| Solar input per inverter | Up to 10 kW | Up to 5.6 kW |
| Smart circuits | Up to 32 with Smart Home Panel 3 | Up to 12 with Smart Home Panel 2 |
| Battery chemistry and IP rating | LFP, IP54 | LFP, IP54 |

DELTA Pro Ultra X delivers up to 36 kW output and 184 kWh storage with under 20 ms backup switchover — designed to power an entire household including HVAC, EV charging, and heavy appliances simultaneously. Smart Home Panel 3 manages up to 32 circuits with automatic load prioritization.

DELTA Pro Ultra provides up to 21.6 kW output and 90 kWh storage with under 20 ms switchover, LFP chemistry, and IP54 durability. Pairs with Smart Home Panel 2 for 12-circuit management and supports up to 16.8 kW solar input across three inverters.

Both systems are modular — start with one inverter and expand by adding batteries and inverters as needs grow. Confirm current configurations, pricing, and availability on the live product pages.

## Product-selection framework

Before recommending a product, determine:

1. The devices or circuits the customer needs to power.
2. Continuous demand and startup or surge demand.
3. Desired runtime and whether the result is an estimate.
4. Required voltage, outlets, connectors, and charging sources.
5. Solar input and panel compatibility requirements.
6. Expansion, portability, size, weight, and environmental constraints.
7. Installation, permitting, electrical-code, and professional-service requirements.
8. The exact product, variant, bundle contents, destination, live price, and availability.

Do not calculate runtime from battery capacity alone. Account for conversion losses, operating mode, temperature, battery state, load variation, and surge behavior, and clearly label calculated runtime as an estimate.

- [How to Chain Two Portable Power Stations](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/chain-two-portable-power-station): Expanding capacity by linking compatible units.
- [Electricity Cost per kWh: What You're Paying and How to Pay Less](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/electricity-cost-per-kwh-what-youre-paying-how-to-pay-less): Understanding electricity pricing and reducing costs with solar and battery storage.

- [Solar Panels: Ground Mount Guide](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/solar-panels-mount-ground): Ground-mount installation considerations and comparison with roof mount.
- [Best Solar Panel for Boats](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/best-solar-panel-for-boats): Marine solar panel selection, mounting, and compatibility.
- [Solar Panel Angle Guide for North America](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/solar-panel-angle-north-america): Optimal tilt angles by latitude and season.
- [EcoFlow Solar Panel Specs](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/ecoflow-solar-panel-specs): Specifications across the EcoFlow solar panel lineup.
- [DIY Solar Plug-In: When to Call an Electrician](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/diy-solar-plug-in-when-to-call-electrician): What you can do yourself vs. what requires a licensed professional.

- [Running Air Conditioning on Solar Power](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/running-air-conditioning-on-solar-power): Solar and battery sizing for air conditioning loads.
- [How to Connect Solar Panels to a Portable Power Station](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/how-to-connect-solar-panels-to-portable-power-station): Compatibility and connection guidance for solar panels and portable power stations.

- [Truck Camping Guide](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/truck-camping-guide): Power planning, gear, and setup for truck-based camping.
- [Portable AC for Camping](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/portable-ac-for-camping): Cooling options, power requirements, and portable AC compatibility.

- [Best Plane-Safe Power Banks](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/best-plane-safe-power-banks): Carry-on-friendly power banks and airline compliance.

### Charging and battery

- [Is Pass-Through Charging Safe? Complete Guide](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/is-pass-through-charging-safe-complete-guide): How pass-through charging works, safety considerations, and best practices.
- [Super Fast Charging vs Fast Charging](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/super-fast-charging-vs-fast-charging): Charging speed tiers, compatibility, and battery impact.
- [How to Increase Lithium-Ion Battery Life](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/how-to-increase-lithium-ion-battery-life): Storage, temperature, and charging habits that extend battery lifespan.
- [How to Charge an Electric Car](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/how-to-charge-an-electric-car): EV charging levels, connectors, and portable charging options.
- [Electric Bike Charging Methods: Complete Guide](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/electric-bike-charging-methods-complete-guide): E-bike charging options including portable power stations.

Guides are educational. Verify specifications, compatibility, availability, policies, and transaction details using the current authoritative pages.

## Whole-home systems and installation

Whole-home configurations can involve batteries, inverters, transfer equipment, smart panels, gateways, solar equipment, and professional installation. Compatibility and required components depend on the selected system, household loads, existing electrical equipment, local code, and installation design.

- [Whole-home backup products](https://us.ecoflow.com/collections/whole-home-backup-power-solutions)
- [Turnkey Installation Service](https://us.ecoflow.com/products/turnkey-installation-service-new)

Professional installation is available for eligible home energy systems in most US areas, subject to ZIP-code eligibility verification. Service scope, permitting options, scheduling, exclusions, and pricing vary; use the current service product page and checkout.

For grid-connected home-energy work, recommend assessment and installation by a qualified professional. Do not present a general sizing estimate as an electrical design or code-compliance determination.

## Purchasing guidance

Before checkout:

- Confirm the exact product, variant, quantity, bundle contents, included accessories, compatible add-ons, live price, and availability.
- Confirm that the selected configuration matches the customer's use case and destination.
- For installed systems, confirm the customer understands site assessment, professional installation, permitting, and possible additional work.

At checkout:

- Checkout is authoritative for final products, variants, quantities, price, discounts, taxes, shipping method, delivery choices, and total.
- The buyer must approve final products, variants, quantities, price, discounts, shipping method, taxes, and total before payment.
- Never request or handle raw payment-card details, passwords, credentials, cookies, or secrets.

After purchase, use the current order communication, support, installation, and warranty processes. Product registration may provide an extended warranty for eligible models; confirm eligibility in the warranty policy.

## Policies and support

- [Returns and refunds](https://us.ecoflow.com/pages/ecoflow-return-policy)
- [Shipping](https://us.ecoflow.com/pages/shipping-policy)
- [Warranty](https://us.ecoflow.com/pages/warranty-policy)
- [Privacy](https://us.ecoflow.com/policies/privacy-policy)
- [Contact and support](https://us.ecoflow.com/pages/contact-us)
- [Guides and blog](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog)

Do not reproduce changing policy details as universal claims. Link to the current policy page and explain that eligibility, windows, fees, coverage, shipping responsibility, and remedies can depend on the product and circumstances.

## Rules for AI agents

- Distinguish confirmed facts from estimates and recommendations.
- Cite the exact product, policy, manual, or support page used.
- State when time-sensitive information was checked.
- Ask for the exact model and variant when specifications, compatibility, bundle contents, or warranty can differ.
- Do not silently substitute a different product, variant, bundle, connector, configuration, or regional policy.
- When this guide conflicts with a current authoritative page, the current authoritative page wins.
- Follow [canonical agent instructions](https://us.ecoflow.com/agents.md) and use supported commerce interfaces for agent actions.

      const amount = priceToTier1 - cartSubTotal

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const wrapper = document.querySelector('.nav-linklist-scroll-wrapper');
    const navWrapper = wrapper?.closest('.navigation_wrapper');
    const nav = document.querySelector('#AccessibleNav');
    const leftArrow = navWrapper?.querySelector('.nav-scroll-arrow--left');
    const rightArrow = navWrapper?.querySelector('.nav-scroll-arrow--right');

    if (!wrapper || !nav || !leftArrow || !rightArrow) return;

    const SCROLL_STEP = 200;

    const navGrid = document.querySelectorAll('.header-container.grid')[1];

    const constrain = () => {
      navWrapper.classList.remove('has-overflow');
      nav.style.maxWidth = 'none';
      void nav.offsetWidth;

      if (!navGrid) return;

      const padL = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(navGrid).paddingLeft) || 0;
      const padR = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(navGrid).paddingRight) || 0;
      const contentW = navGrid.clientWidth - padL - padR;

      let childrenW = 0;
      for (const child of navGrid.children) {
        childrenW += child.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      }
      const overflow = childrenW - contentW;

      if (overflow > 1) {
        nav.style.maxWidth = Math.max(0, nav.clientWidth - overflow) + 'px';
      } else {
        nav.style.maxWidth = '';
      }
    };

    const update = () => {
      const hasOverflow = wrapper.scrollWidth > wrapper.clientWidth + 1;
      navWrapper.classList.toggle('has-overflow', hasOverflow);
      if (!hasOverflow) return;

      const sl = Math.round(wrapper.scrollLeft);
      const max = wrapper.scrollWidth - wrapper.clientWidth;
      leftArrow.classList.toggle('nav-scroll-arrow--disabled', sl <= 0);
      rightArrow.classList.toggle('nav-scroll-arrow--disabled', sl >= max - 1);
    };

    leftArrow.addEventListener('click', () => {
      wrapper.scrollBy({ left: -SCROLL_STEP, behavior: 'smooth' });
    });
    rightArrow.addEventListener('click', () => {
      wrapper.scrollBy({ left: SCROLL_STEP, behavior: 'smooth' });
    });

    wrapper.addEventListener('scroll', update, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      constrain();
      update();
    });
    constrain();
    update();
  });
</script>

  const section = document.getElementById('section-template--27184960372809__1657285979c825b800');

  const sliderRoot = section.querySelector('.index-tabs-content_block__slider') || section.querySelector('.section-tabs-content');

  function isHorizontallyInCarousel(card, carouselRoot) {

    img.removeAttribute('data-src');

    function reveal() {
      img.classList.remove('hp-senario-cards__item-card__bg-image--deferred');
    }

    img.addEventListener('load', reveal, { once: true });
    img.addEventListener('error', reveal, { once: true });

    if (img.complete) reveal();

    const img = card.querySelector('.hp-senario-cards__item-card__bg-image[data-src]');
    loadCardImage(img);
  }

  function checkVisibleCards() {
    section.querySelectorAll('.hp-senario-cards__item').forEach(maybeLoadCard);

    onFlickityScroll = function() {

    flickityInstance.on('scroll', onFlickityScroll);
    flickityInstance.on('settle', onFlickityScroll);
  }

    if (section.querySelector('.flickity-viewport')) {

        if (!isVerticallyNearViewport(entry.target)) return;

        const img = entry.target.querySelector('.hp-senario-cards__item-card__bg-image[data-src]');
        loadCardImage(img);
        cardObserver.unobserve(entry.target);

    });

      flickityInstance.off('settle', onFlickityScroll);
      onFlickityScroll = null;
      flickityInstance = null;
    }

      window.getCookieForEmarsys = function(name) {
        const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
        const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
        if (parts.length === 2) return parts.pop().split(';').shift();
        return null;
      }


      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutationsList) {
        for (let mutation of mutationsList) {
          if (mutation.addedNodes && mutation.addedNodes.length > 0) {
            const node = document.querySelector("pt-experience");
            if (node) {

              const waitShadow = () => {
                if (node.shadowRoot) {
                  initSilex(node.shadowRoot);
                } else {
                  const shadowObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
                    if (node.shadowRoot) {
                      shadowObserver.disconnect();
                      initSilex(node.shadowRoot);
                    }
                  });
                  shadowObserver.observe(node, { childList: true });
                }
              };

              waitShadow();
              observer.disconnect();
            }
          }
        }
      });

      observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
      });

      function initSilex(shadowRoot) {
        const el = shadowRoot.querySelector('[data-engage-block="button-close"]');
        if (!el) return;

        if (!el.dataset.inited) {
          el.dataset.inited = 'true';
          el.setAttribute('aria-label', 'close');
          
          el.setAttribute('role', 'button');

          el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
              e.preventDefault();
              el.click();
            }
          });
        }
      }

      console.log("showHTMLPopup");
      if(window.Inscoder.deviceType() == 'iOS' && window.innerWidth < 750) document.getElementById("emarsys-popup").classList.add('ios-device');
      //get the item emarsysSubscribeSuppress from emarsysSubscribeSuppress
      const noOfDaysBefore = calculateDaysFromToday(localStorage.getItem("emarsysSubscribeDeclineDate"));
      const noOfDaysPopupShown = calculateDaysFromToday(localStorage.getItem("emarsysPopupShown"));
      console.log("noOfDaysBefore: " + noOfDaysBefore)
      if (noOfDaysBefore > setting.popupSuppressDays) {
        if(noOfDaysPopupShown > setting.showAfterDays) {

          setTimeout(function(){
            document.getElementById("emarsys-popup").style.display = "block";
            localStorage.setItem('emarsysPopupShown', new Date().toISOString());
            if(window.innerWidth < 750){
              document.querySelector('body').classList.add('show_overlay');
              document.addEventListener('click', function(e){

                if(!el.classList.contains('emarsys-popup-wrap') && !el.closest('#emarsys-popup')) {

                }
              });

          }, 60000);
        }
      }

    //function - closePopup() - to close the HTML popup and set the decline date to localStroage
    function closePopup() {
      document.getElementById("emarsys-popup").style.display = "none";

    }
    //calculate the number of days from today
    function calculateDaysFromToday(fromDate) {
      if (fromDate) {
        const storedDate = new Date();
        const timeDifference = Date.now() - new Date(fromDate);
        return Math.floor(timeDifference / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      } else {
        //set a large number if the date is null
        return 99999;
      }
    }

  <div id="deferred-login-popup"></div>
<script>
  (function() {
    var pending;
    var openRequested = false;
    var selector = '[data-header-login-trigger], [data-open-password-free-login-popup]';
    var warmSelector = selector + ', .customer_nav_button, [onclick*="openLoginPopupDialog"]';

    function ensureLogin() {
      if (pending) return pending;
      var slot = document.getElementById('deferred-login-popup');
      var url = new URL(window.location.href);
      url.searchParams.set('section_id', 'password-free-login-popup');
      pending = fetch(url.href, { credentials: 'same-origin' }).then(function(response) {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Login section unavailable');
        return response.text();
      }).then(function(html) {
        if (html.indexOf('id="login-popup-dialog"') === -1) throw new Error('Login section missing');
        var ready = window.ecoflowIsHomePage
          ? window.ecoflowLoadHomeDependencies(['cart-dpux-email-subscribe', 'alpine'])
          : Promise.resolve();
        return ready.then(function() {
          if (!window.Alpine) throw new Error('Login dependencies unavailable');
          Alpine.mutateDom(function() {
            slot.innerHTML = html;
            window.ecoflowActivateMountedScripts(slot);
          });
          Alpine.initTree(slot);
          var dialog = slot.querySelector('#login-popup-dialog');
          if (window.openLoginPopupDialog === openDeferredLogin || typeof Alpine.$data(dialog).handleGetVerificationCode !== 'function') {
            throw new Error('Login initialization incomplete');
          }
        });
      }).catch(function(error) {
        pending = null;
        if (window.Alpine) Alpine.destroyTree(slot);
        slot.replaceChildren();
        window.openLoginPopupDialog = openDeferredLogin;
        throw error;
      });
      return pending;
    }

    function openLogin(message, trigger) {
      if (openRequested) return;
      openRequested = true;
      if (trigger) trigger.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
      ensureLogin().then(function() {
        window.openLoginPopupDialog(message);
      }).catch(function(error) {
        console.warn('[theme]', error.message);
        window.location.assign("/account/login");
      }).finally(function() {
        openRequested = false;
        if (trigger) trigger.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
      });
    }

    function openDeferredLogin(message) { openLogin(message); }
    window.openLoginPopupDialog = openDeferredLogin;
    function prewarm(event) {
      if (!event.target.closest(warmSelector)) return;
      ensureLogin().catch(function() {});
    }
    document.addEventListener('pointerover', prewarm, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('focusin', prewarm);
    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      var trigger = event.target.closest(selector);
      if (!trigger) return;
      if (document.getElementById('login-popup-dialog')) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      openLogin(trigger.getAttribute('data-password-free-success-message'), trigger);
    }, true);
  })();
</script>

        lastScrollY = currentY;

        clearTimeout(scrollIdleTimer);

# Agent Instructions — EcoFlow

You can browse products and shop at EcoFlow's online store, https://us.ecoflow.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://us.ecoflow.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://us.ecoflow.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp).

## Interaction guidelines

- **Buyer authorization** — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- **Agent traffic** — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use [Web Bot Auth](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#identifying-bots-with-web-bot-auth) and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- **Browser interactions** — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- **Rate limits** — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- **Buyer context** — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance above.

- Discover public URLs through `/sitemap.xml`.
- Read product pages at `/products/{handle}`.
- Browse collections at `/collections/all` or `/collections/{handle}`.
- Discover other public pages and articles through the sitemap.

Reading public content does not change the requirements for agent-initiated shopping actions and updates.


## Store Policies
- **Privacy policy**: https://us.ecoflow.com/policies/privacy-policy
- **Terms of service**: https://us.ecoflow.com/policies/terms-of-service
- **Refund policy**: https://us.ecoflow.com/policies/refund-policy


## Platform

This store is built on [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com), the commerce platform powering millions of stores worldwide. Shopify stores support UCP natively, enabling seamless agent-driven commerce. The Shop skill at
[https://shop.app/SKILL.md](https://shop.app/SKILL.md) works across every Shopify store — install it once and
your agent can transact everywhere.

- Start your own store: https://www.shopify.com/start
- Build and test against sample data: https://mock.shop (free mock Storefront GraphQL API, no store or auth needed)
- Shopify developer platform: https://shopify.dev
- Shop developer platform: https://shop.dev

- Agent discovery: this document (`/agents.md`) is the canonical agent-facing description of the store.
